en.t: In the sunlight, he felt self-sufficient.

units.source_text: 从他的身影可以了解到在春光和花丛中，他没有我所感受到的羞耻和虚空。

en.t: From his figure, one could understand that amid the spring light and the flowers, he did not have the shame and emptiness that I felt.

units.source_text: 他所强调的影子，实际上就是存在着的影子本身。

en.t: The shadow he emphasized was, in fact, the existing shadow itself.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，阳光是不能渗进他那坚硬的肌肤的。

en.t: Without a doubt, the sunlight could not penetrate his hard skin.
